solution:
Each number is 8 more than the one before: \(15 + 8 = 23\), \(23 + 8 = 31\); \(33 + 8 = 41\), \(41 + 8 = 49\).

(20, 28, 36) fits: \(20 + 8 = 28\), \(28 + 8 = 36\). (21, 29, 43) and (35, 43, 56) break the step at the third number; (20, 33, 28) breaks it at the second (20 + 8 = 28, not 33).
note: Analogy: (20, 33, 28) breaks the +8 step at its second number, not its third; the line said all three others broke at the third. Key B unchanged.
